name: Cagliari

routes.outcome: Official regional page states that the public can consult cadastral geometry through SardegnaSIT navigators; cadastral census data is restricted to entitled public offices.
Official SardegnaMappe viewer JavaScript inspected. It configures the Agenzia delle Entrate WMS CP.CadastralZoning and CP.CadastralParcel layers in EPSG:6706.
Official national WMS capabilities loaded; CP.CadastralParcel is present. A bounded GetFeatureInfo attempt with application/json and EPSG:4258 returned InvalidFormat.
Anonymous WMS GetFeatureInfo returned one parcel bounded box near the WUP point but no usable stable identity or full polygon, so it was not retained.

Official regional WFS capabilities list dbu:particelle (Catasto - Particelle). The WFS page warns that cadastral layers are experimentally available only to some regional offices, while the public endpoint still returned a bounded anonymous response.

Schema exposed safe fields comune, foglio, numero, sezione, allegato, sviluppo, area, geom, com_fg_plla_ter, and com_fg_plla_fab. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, or tax/account fields were requested.
Bounded anonymous GeoJSON response returned totalFeatures/numberMatched 18 and numberReturned 3. Three unchanged Polygon geometries were retained with canonical composite native identities.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: SardegnaMappe viewer plus Sardegna SIT WFS; national fallback WMS is Agenzia delle Entrate ows01.php
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Native regional WFS EPSG:3003; retained request/output CRS EPSG:4326
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: com_fg_plla_ter (Comune/foglio/particella/sezione composite supplied by the native source)

sourceFieldMapping.comune: observed source component, not retained as a separate property
sourceFieldMapping.foglio: observed source component, not retained as a separate property
sourceFieldMapping.numero: observed source component, not retained as a separate property
sourceFieldMapping.sezione: observed source component, not retained as a separate property
sourceFieldMapping.geom: retained unchanged from bounded response, output CRS EPSG:4326

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: The source schema exposes com_fg_plla_ter; each retained id exactly matches the returned source value (B354_0014_00169_A, B354_0014_00171_A, B354_0014_00172_A).

qualification.reason: A real public first-party regional cadastral service and bounded ID-plus-geometry response were obtained, but source integration/admission remains held pending independent serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The sample is limited to three nearby polygons; the WFS query matched 18 features and is not a citywide completeness test.
The national WMS point-level result lacked a stable identity/full polygon and was not used as retained geometry.
The regional WFS page documents restricted cadastral census access; only public geometry and safe native composite IDs were used.
The packet is complete as a research record, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The public regional WFS schema, CRS, composite identity, and bounded geometry response are verified. The service's public coverage/update semantics and exact cadastral legal status of the returned fields remain uncertain. Runtime/admission remains held.
